messages.content:
<document id=DOC_req_open_enum>
Required: PostgreSQL, Redis or similar databases.
</document>

State whether the candidate meets the requirement below, and say whether
you matched a named item or judged something equivalent.

response.text:
Yes — the candidate meets the requirement by equivalence, not by a named match.

MySQL is not PostgreSQL or Redis, but it is a similar relational database to PostgreSQL, which the requirement allows under “or similar databases.”
